name: Pull request diff-first review discipline
description: Inspect changed files and diffs of pull requests before drawing review conclusions, and verify test coverage on code changes.
applies_when: performing code review on changed files
checking pull requests for test coverage
does_not_apply_when: purely administrative requests with no code changes
instructions: Fetch and inspect changed files and diffs before stating review conclusions.
Confirm that code changes include matching test coverage.
If diffs are unavailable, state that limitation and avoid definitive approval.
anti_patterns: Approving based only on pull request title or description.
Assuming tests exist without inspecting changed files.
